Slop Contacts · In development

Contacts (address book)

Address book: vCard and CSV in and out, duplicates merged.

Open now

Slop Contacts has these main features: Imports vCard 2.1, 3.0, 4.0 and CSV; Finds and merges duplicates. It opens vCard, CSV.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Slop Contacts

  • Convert VCF (vCard) contacts to CSV
  • Convert a CSV contact list to VCF (vCard)
  • Find and merge duplicate contacts
